brief: A meeting scheduler where time flows as a river — free slots are calm water, meetings are bridges

dominant_strengths: Evocative title and subtitle hint at a poetic river metaphor that could differentiate from generic calendar UIs
Blue gradient backdrop genuinely reads as water, supporting the conceptual framing of the brief
dominant_weaknesses: Layout is essentially empty — one bar, one line, one FAB — failing to express the river/bridges metaphor visually
Time label '4PM' shows broken overlapping glyphs, signaling unfinished craft and damaging trust in the prototype
No differentiation between free slots (calm water) and meetings (bridges); the central rule line and bar feel arbitrary
fix_priorities: Render the river as a continuous vertical/horizontal flow with distinct bridge components crossing it for meetings
Fix the time-stamp typography overlap and establish a clear time ruler along the river's edge
Populate with multiple time slots and sample meetings so the metaphor and information density become legible
Introduce subtle motion (flowing gradient) to reinforce the 'time flows like water' promise
rationale.norman_balance: Mild visceral appeal from the blue gradient is undermined by near-zero behavioral utility and only thin reflective payoff from the title.
rationale.intent_fit: The screen gestures at the river concept verbally but fails to deliver the bridges-as-meetings visual system the brief requires.
